name: My AI tools
title: Two tools I built to work faster with AI
tagline: An editor that writes my changes straight into the page, and a tweaker that turns every visual decision into a slider.

heroMedia.alt: The tweaker beside the live home page: sliders for dot spacing, dot size, drift, curl and timing of the logo animation

intro: I build my portfolio with Claude Code. These are the two tools I made so I can change copy and visuals with my own hands instead of describing every change in a prompt.

sections.label: The editor
sections.heading: Rewrite the page by clicking on it
body: On my case-study pages, a local-only Edit text button outlines every line of copy. I click a line, rewrite it, and the new wording is written straight back into that case study’s file, so the next refresh rebuilds the page from it.
The same mode swaps the image on any screen, places the mouse pointer on a screenshot, and pins a new callout wherever I click.

media.alt: A case-study page in edit mode: every line of copy outlined, Mouse and Swap buttons on the screenshot, and a Done editing button
media.caption: Edit mode on a case-study page.
media.tab: Race to a faster first demo

sections.label: The tweaker
sections.heading: Every visual decision becomes a slider
body: The tweaker is a Claude Code skill: whenever something visual gets built, it comes with a live panel beside the real page and a control for every value that shapes how it looks or moves.
I drag, pin a version to compare against, slow the motion down, and press Save. The values are written into the site and become its defaults.

media.alt: The tweaker beside the case-study deck: sliders for card size, spacing, neighbour drop and corner softness
media.caption: Tuning the case-study deck.

reflection.label: Why
reflection.heading: Built to make me more productive with AI
body: Both tools run only on my machine; the live site never loads them.
